title: StatusSnapshot
description: daemon::operations::StatusSnapshot, written to status.json and overwritten in full on every invocation (not appended).

health_state.description: The daemon's SystemState at the moment this was written (e.g. Healthy, Degraded, ReadOnly, EmergencyShutdown). See daemon::health for the authoritative variant list and what allows/blocks new entries at each state.

last_decision.description: A single free-text summary. With more than one configured pair-set, this is a semicolon-joined summary across all of them, e.g. "EURUSD/GBPUSD: order_submitted; USDJPY/AUDUSD: no_divergence": not a structured per-pair-set field, to avoid changing this schema for existing tooling that reads it.

paused.description: True if the PAUSED kill-switch file was present when this cycle ran.
